transcript.en: Are you serious? We've been friends for years.
transcript.zh: 你认真的吗？我们已经是多年的朋友了。

transcript.en: We can't just change that overnight.
transcript.zh: 这层关系不能一夜之间就改变。

transcript.en: I know. I never had the guts to tell you until today.
transcript.zh: 我知道。我一直没有勇气告诉你，直到今天。

transcript.en: So what do you say? Are you willing to give me a shot?
transcript.zh: 所以你觉得怎么样？你愿意给我一个机会吗？

transcript.en: Uh, uh...
transcript.zh: 呃，呃……

transcript.en: Alright, so an interesting dialogue,
transcript.zh: 好了，一段很有趣的对话，

transcript.en: and it opens up a cultural point.
transcript.zh: 它引出了一个文化点。

transcript.en: That's right. So in the dialogue,
transcript.zh: 没错。所以在对话中，

transcript.en: I'm going to ask you to give me a shot.
transcript.zh: 我来问你 give me a shot。

transcript.en: So in the dialogue, the guy was asking her if she
transcript.zh: 在对话中，那位男士在问她是否愿意

transcript.en: would be his girlfriend, right?
transcript.zh: 做他女朋友，对吧？

transcript.en: Right, but I guess it's not very common,
transcript.zh: 对，但我觉得这并不常见，

transcript.en: among adults at least, in English-speaking countries.
transcript.zh: 至少在英语国家的成年人中不常见。

transcript.en: Yeah, we don't say like, okay,
transcript.zh: 是的，我们不会说，好的，

transcript.en: so please will you be my boyfriend now?
transcript.zh: 那么请问你现在愿意做我男朋友吗？

transcript.en: Right, right, right.
transcript.zh: 对对对。

transcript.en: You would do that maybe in high school.
transcript.zh: 你可能在高中时会那样做。

transcript.en: Yeah, but even then I think it's still a little funny.
transcript.zh: 是的，但即便那时候我觉得还是有点好笑。

transcript.en: I think for us, when we start to have romantic
transcript.zh: 我觉得对我们来说，当我们开始一段

transcript.en: relationships, it just sort of happens naturally,
transcript.zh: 浪漫关系时，它自然而然地就发生了，

transcript.en: right?
transcript.zh: 对吧？

transcript.en: You never really have this conversation,
transcript.zh: 你从来没有真正有过这样的对话，

transcript.en: will you be my boyfriend?
transcript.zh: '你愿意做我男朋友吗？'

transcript.en: Right, I guess afterwards you just start talking about
transcript.zh: 对，我想之后你们就开始聊

transcript.en: other things,
transcript.zh: 其他事情，

transcript.en: which you just consider that you guys are already
transcript.zh: 然后你默认你们已经是

transcript.en: boyfriend and girlfriend.
transcript.zh: 男女朋友了。

transcript.en: But there's no real...
transcript.zh: 但没有真正的……

transcript.en: There's no official starting point.
transcript.zh: 没有正式的起点。

transcript.en: Yeah, there's no official point that says, okay,
transcript.zh: 是的，没有一个正式的节点说，好的，

transcript.en: now we are boyfriend and girlfriend.
transcript.zh: 现在我们是男女朋友了。

transcript.en: Which is interesting because in other countries they
transcript.zh: 这很有趣，因为在其他国家，

transcript.en: do go through the formality of asking somebody to
transcript.zh: 他们确实会走一遍正式邀请某人

transcript.en: become their boyfriend.
transcript.zh: 成为自己男朋友的流程。

transcript.en: Yeah, but even, you know,
transcript.zh: 是的，但即便是，你知道，

transcript.en: like 20 or 30 years ago in English-speaking countries,
transcript.zh: 在英语国家二三十年前，

transcript.en: you would do this.
transcript.zh: 你会这样做。

transcript.en: Oh yeah, of course.
transcript.zh: 哦，是啊，当然。

transcript.en: And it was called going steady.
transcript.zh: 那时候叫 going steady。

transcript.en: Going steady.
transcript.zh: Going steady.

transcript.en: So you would ask, will you go steady with me?
transcript.zh: 所以你会问，你愿意跟我 going steady 吗？

transcript.en: That means let's become a stable couple.
transcript.zh: 意思是让我们成为一对稳定的情侣。

transcript.en: Exactly.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: All right, so we want to hear your stories and well,
transcript.zh: 好了，我们想听听你们的故事，

transcript.en: how do you do it in your country?
transcript.zh: 在你们国家是怎么做的？

transcript.en: Do you ask someone out,
transcript.zh: 你会约某人出去，

transcript.en: do you maybe just give them the first kiss
transcript.zh: 或者你直接给他/她初吻

transcript.en: and that's an automatic yes?
transcript.zh: 然后就算自动答应了？

transcript.en: Well, I don't know, but I'm looking forward to hearing
transcript.zh: 嗯，我不知道，但我期待

transcript.en: from our listeners.
transcript.zh: 听到我们听众的分享。

transcript.en: So guys, check out our website EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 所以大家，来看看我们的网站 EnglishPod.com。

transcript.en: You can leave your questions and comments there.
transcript.zh: 你可以在那里留下你的问题和评论。

transcript.en: All right, we'll see you guys there
transcript.zh: 好的，我们在那里见，

transcript.en: and until next time.
transcript.zh: 下期再见。

transcript.en: Goodbye.
transcript.zh: 拜拜。

transcript.zh: 🎵 音乐播放中 🎵
